test.name: Spec 0010 spike: getsid for a child and for a process in another session

expected: getsid(pid) returns the session of a child spawned with SETSID (equal to its pid) and of such a process after its parent died, read from a process in another session (spec 0010 AC-9, Adapter macOS row Session)
actual: getsid(child) = child pid while the spike's own session is a different one; for the orphan, getsid from the spike (not its parent, another session) returned its pid, equal to the sid the old daemon recorded at spawn; no EPERM across sessions on macOS 27. getsid(1) = 1. Absent pid and zombie: ESRCH.
